text: Both in progress. #1 (errors.go / TestErrorUnwrap): ~5 min. #2 (response_writer.go / TestResponseWriterStatusCode): ~5 min.
Acknowledged: bug in tree.go (TestRouteParamsNotEmpty). Investigating now.
errors.go / TestErrorUnwrap: fix identified, verifying now.
response_writer.go / TestResponseWriterStatusCode: fix identified, verifying now.
Fixed: Error.Unwrap now has a value receiver so errors.Is/As work through gin.Error values. Verifying with the full suite.
Fixed: Error.Unwrap now uses a value receiver, so errors.Is/errors.As/errors.Unwrap work through gin.Error values (not just pointers). Verified with a probe test and the full suite passes.
Fixed: WriteHeader now returns early when headers were already written, so a later WriteHeader can no longer override the status code that was already sent. Verified; full suite passes.

Fixed: findCaseInsensitivePathRec took n.children[0] instead of the wildcard child (which is always last), so a node with several children plus a wildcard child panicked with "invalid node type". Now uses the last child. Verified; full suite passes.
Fixed: FileAttachment now escapes the filename (backslashes and double quotes) before putting it in the Content-Disposition header, via a new escapeQuotes helper. Verified; full suite passes.

Fixed: NegotiateFormat indexed offer[i] while looping over accepted, so an offer shorter than the accepted format panicked (index out of range). The loop now bounds i by both lengths. Verified; full suite passes.
Still investigating tree.go for the empty-param-name route case (TestRouteParamsNotEmpty). All other reported bugs (#1, #2, #5, #7, #8) are fixed and the full test suite passes.
